content:
"Malaysian authorities have suspended efforts to locate Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, an Indian visitor who vanished when a pavement in Kuala Lumpur gave way beneath her on 23 August, forming a deep sinkhole. She fell around 8 metres and has not been located, with only her slippers recovered so far despite extensive efforts.

***

Specialist teams have deployed tracker dogs, remote cameras and ground‑penetrating radar while scouring the underground drainage network. Crews have also used high‑pressure water jets and excavators to clear debris in the hope of finding clues to her whereabouts.

***

* Officials say the operation has grown increasingly perilous for crews underground, with unstable ground and poor visibility complicating every effort.

***

A minister in the prime minister’s department, Dr Zaliha Mustafa, announced that the mission was halted after experts judged the danger to rescue staff too great, especially for divers who were briefly sent in but withdrawn before reaching an obstruction.

***

Authorities revealed that a soil slip had been reported at the same spot in the previous year, highlighting ongoing ground instability in the area and raising questions about urban infrastructure safety in Malaysia’s capital. Is there else I can help with?"
